name: Party role
description: What an organization does in a contracting process, per OCDS. One organization may hold several roles in the same process, which is why roles live on the party rather than being implied by where the organization is mentioned.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Procuring entity
hasDefinedTerm.description: The organization running the process, which is not always the buyer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Tenderer
hasDefinedTerm.description: Submitted a bid. Publishing unsuccessful tenderers, not only the winner, is what makes a competition auditable.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Funder
hasDefinedTerm.description: Provided the money, often a different tier of government or a donor.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Review body
hasDefinedTerm.description: Handles complaints and challenges to the process.
